subject.title: Lawndale School District Board, Trustee Area 2

text: My late husband, Councilman Larry Rudolph and I lived our 55 ½ year Married life in Lawndale. We raised our Three Sons here and ALL Five of US Graduated from Lawndale Schools.

I have proven my Dedication and Commitment to Youth by donating 45+ years to Lawndale Little League Baseball; 12 ½ years to the City of Lawndale's Parks, Recreation Social Services Commission; Lawndale Kiwanis Club Charter Board Member and Lawndale High School Key Club Advisor for 14 years.

THANK YOU for allowing me to be YOUR Representative on this Board for the past years. I have served YOU well. I have proven my Accessibility to ALL and I have been YOUR VOICE for the Betterment of Education for ALL of Our Students, Our Schools and Our Community.

I am seeking Re-Election to the Lawndale Elementary School Board because of my continuing interest in the Quality of Life for Lawndale's Young People.
I need YOUR support.
TOGETHER we can SUCCESSFULLY move our CHILDREN through The 21st CENTURY.

text: As a South Bay father, I'm passionate about improving LESD. My girls went to Mitchell's preschool, Smith Elementary, and currently attend Addams Middle. If elected, I would bring firsthand knowledge of families' experiences in the district today. Since 2019, I've been heavily involved as a volunteer and elected parent leader, and I bring 20 years experience as an educator. With half our students performing below average in math and reading, I will passionately push for more rigorous academics, exciting classroom experiences, and robust family support.

From 2020, I was Smith's PTA President, Parliamentarian and Treasurer. District-wide, I was the Council PTA President and District Parent Advisory Committee President. Last year, I successfully advocated for a new PTA at Addams and a new district program for gifted/high achieving students.

Every day, as Academic Services Director of a nonprofit learning center, I directly support struggling and low-income students. I provide reading/math, Advanced Placement class, SAT instruction and help students apply to college.

A vote for Sunny puts a current parent/educator in the boardroom. I know how students learn and will be a passionate advocate for parents and students, determined to push LESD to do its best for all students.
